banner.title: The Dragon promotion batch three - issue 4 complete
banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round six, the third rules promotion batch under the R968 format: four records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - issue 4 complete (chr, cmv, cfe, cfc - the dragon article's combat variants, the cleric/elf variants and their familiar tables), 447 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). THE BATCH CEILING RAISED (Curtiss, 2026-10-31): the spec files run small, so whole issue groups ride per round now - this batch is 214984 bytes of Lua in a ~240KB spec, nearly double the R969 precedent. Cumulative 15 of the walked 79-round Dragon set, 64 remaining.
